body: Round 1 (c0eb536c..4bb6092d), Verdict: correct; P2 high: no test caught a broken no-flag changed-set lookup (the CI entry point): an empty set, a dropped -z, a reversed range and check=False all passed the 13 tests, and the checkout test's changed-file check could not fail on PR 415's finding-free files. Fixed in 77bb5753: test_with_no_mode_flag_the_change_is_origin_main_to_head_and_a_missing_base_fails runs a copy of the script in a temporary repository with a real origin/main, after an update-branch merge: the change's own hits and the stranded row fail, main's hit in an unchanged file warns, and a missing base fails closed; validation 6a kills five lookup mutants.

Round 1, P3 high: git diff's default rename detection listed only a renamed file's new path, so the old path's baseline row warned forever. Fixed in 77bb5753 with --no-renames (a rename changes both paths, as test.yaml's decide step reads them); the same test covers it, and its mutant is killed (validation 6a).

Round 1, P3 high: with explicit files and no mode flag, a file counts as changed only under the repository-relative name git prints, so a manual run naming an absolute path warns where it failed before. Not changed: no caller does this (CI and the tests use the tracked scan or a mode flag), and the docstring already says paths as git ls-files prints them; residual for the orchestrator.

Round 1, P3 high: the usage text put [<file>...] after --changed, whose nargs='*' swallows following names. Fixed in 77bb5753: the docstring's usage lists the files before --changed <path>... | --all.

Round 1, P3 low-medium: the checkout test's substring match could fail falsely on a changed root-level file whose name ends a warned path. Fixed in 77bb5753: each warning line's path is parsed exactly and compared with the changed set.

Round 1, P3 informational: no test pins the git isolation (inherited environment, PATH's git, --no-ext-diff/--no-textconv, the -c options). Not changed: the task is security: false and its threat row for the script is residual; plan 024 item 7's isolation tests bind security: true tasks. Residual.

Round 1 note (evidence integrity): the unchanged regime-ci.py carries five unbaselined hits (65 R6; 71, 72, 90, 246 R4), not only line 65; the report and validation record all five as warnings, and no regime-ci.py row is added.
